mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a comfortable 78 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a First Quarter moon phase visible later tonight.

The Verona Recreation Department is now offering easy online registration for all programs. You can also apply for rebates if you upgrade to high-efficiency toilets or install a rain barrel to manage stormwater.
Today features the Epic Systems User Group Meeting and evening trivia, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and various live music events occurring tomorrow.
In a report from last Friday, local police responded to a situation where a driver was found unresponsive behind the wheel and was subsequently arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the Caramel Chocolate Pecan. You have plenty of time to enjoy a scoop as Culver's is open until 10 PM tonight.
